company.name: Serro
company.stage: Pre-seed; founded around 2025; previously ByTeams; design-partner and early-customer stage

company.funding: $1M-$1.2M pre-seed announced June 30, 2025, led by 10vc with Mashup Ventures participating

evaluation.summary: Serro is building an Agentic Technical Program Manager and coordination layer for AI-native engineering organizations. It continuously converts signals from Slack, GitHub, Jira, Linear, meetings, email, Notion, and codebases into temporal program memory, reports, drift detection, loops, governance, and analytics. No current public vacancy was found, but recent founding-engineer additions and the founder's public discussion of Serro's AI-native hiring challenge show that the company hires selectively. The work is exceptionally aligned with Paarth's production-agent, evaluation, observability, backend, distributed-systems, and large-scale conversational-data experience; the decisive unknown is whether Serro would support a remote internship-to-full-time or paid trial from India.
strengths: Core product problem is long-horizon agent memory, context routing, temporal reasoning, evaluation, and reliable coordination rather than a generic LLM wrapper
Direct match with production AI agents, LangGraph-style orchestration, tracing, evaluations, observability, backend services, queues, and failure handling
Times Astro experience provides evidence of analyzing production conversations, model behavior, user feedback, cost, and reliability at meaningful scale
Renderperk provides evidence of owning distributed services, queues, storage, payments, CI/CD, metrics, logs, incidents, and parallel workloads
Serro's integrations create concrete engineering problems in ingestion, identity resolution, event ordering, permissions, source conflicts, auditability, and idempotency
Founder publicly says Serro evaluates system design, problem-solving, prompt quality, and code comprehension because more than 90% of its code is AI-written
Recent additions of founding software and AI engineers indicate real technical hiring activity even though no vacancy is currently published
Small funded team and public founder email make a proof-of-work-led direct approach viable
Mountain View headquarters and founder's Silicon Valley network provide strong long-term SF exposure
gaps: No published role or application form was found; the opportunity is inferred and requires founder-led outreach
Remote work from India, internship eligibility, compensation, equity, and employment structure are unknown

evaluation.outreach_angle: Do not send a generic job request. Lead with the hardest part of Serro's promise: proving that live program memory stays correct when Slack, meetings, tickets, and code disagree or arrive out of order. Show production-agent evaluation and observability experience, then offer a compact temporal-memory reliability harness. Ask Jake for a short technical review and propose a remote internship-to-full-time or paid milestone trial only after establishing technical relevance.
evaluation.proposed_artifact: Build a temporal program-memory evaluation harness using a synthetic software initiative spread across Slack messages, meeting transcripts, Jira or Linear events, pull requests, and code changes. Inject contradictions, delayed events, ownership changes, reopened decisions, stale risks, duplicate webhook deliveries, and permission-restricted sources. Produce a versioned program graph with provenance, valid-time and transaction-time fields, confidence, conflict flags, and an audit trail. Evaluate decision accuracy, owner accuracy, stale-fact rate, temporal consistency, conflict resolution, citation coverage, idempotency, and recovery after connector failure; expose traces and a small timeline viewer.

pipeline.next_action: Build or outline the temporal program-memory evaluation harness, then send Jake Kim a concise technical message requesting feedback and proposing a remote internship-to-full-time or paid milestone trial. Contact Tianlin Zhao or Christopher Brady only with differentiated technical questions if there is no founder response.
pipeline.notes: No current public job description or direct application form was found. The LinkedIn Jobs URL is retained as the opportunity URL so the dashboard exposes the best available hiring surface. Recent founding-engineer joins and a public post describing Serro's candidate coding challenge are strong hiring signals, not proof of an active vacancy. Do not mark outreach or application as sent until Paarth explicitly confirms it.
